title_as_printed: Measured water content of CO2 in equilibrium with 20 wt% NaCl aqueous solution. (Temperature error is +-0.1 C and pressure error is +- 0.4 bar)
footnotes_as_printed: none (caption carries: Temperature error is +-0.1 C and pressure error is +- 0.4 bar)
pressure_note: equilibrium cell pressure, held constant during sampling by brine injection; +-0.4 bar; absolute or gauge not stated

value.what: water content of the CO2-rich phase (vapour, or liquid CO2 for rows above the CO2 vapour pressure), printed as y_w in ppm; y_w is the authors' symbol for the water mole fraction in the CO2-rich phase

uncertainty.constant: +-1 % of reading or 4 ppm, whichever is greater (text p.153)

composition.other_species: none; NaCl 99 % purity (Aldrich / Fisher), deionized water

skip_rows.reason: block label rows (temperature + authors' calculated hydrate dissociation pressure) and 'AAD %' summary rows

row_regime_overrides.reason: P above the pure-CO2 vapour pressure at the block temperature (Span-Wagner, approx. 64.3/50.9/45.0/39.7/34.9 bar at 25/15/10/5/0 C): CO2-rich phase is liquid; water content jumps at the same pressure in the printed data

extra_unmapped: Hydrate dissociation pressure per block (authors' model calculation, in the label rows)
AAD % CPA / PC-SAFT per block (authors' model deviations)
notes: Printed as side-by-side temperature blocks (P-bar, y_w - ppm pairs); stacked left block first. Temperature filled from the block header. Degree signs written as 'C'. Method: rocking titanium cell (300 ml), gas sampled via heated line (100 C) to a Yokogawa TDLAS (NOT a chilled-mirror hygrometer); brine of the same concentration pumped into the cell base during sampling. All points measured below the authors' calculated hydrate dissociation pressure (text p.153), so no hydrate rows.
